name: app.visaengine/mcp
title: Visa Engine
description: Visa requirements, visa-needed checks and readiness for 18 routes in the US, UK, Schengen, CA, AU.

tools.name: list_supported_routes
tools.description: Lists the visa routes Visa Engine covers (visa keys, names, kind and country), the destinations its visitor-visa checks accept, and the languages it answers in. Use it to find the visa key for get_visa_requirements or check_visa_readiness, or to tell whether a route is covered at all — for example whether Visa Engine covers the UK Global Talent visa, US O-1A, Schengen visitor visas or Canadian study permits. Routes not listed are not covered.

jurisdiction.description: Only this jurisdiction: US, GB (United Kingdom), EU (Schengen and Germany), CA, AU.

category.description: Only this kind of route: talent (work by distinction), visitor (short trips), student.

locale.description: Language for names and explanations: en, tr, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_visa_requirements
tools.description: Explains what a visa requires: the criteria or checklist, typical evidence, official sources and when they were last checked. Also answers whether a visa is needed to visit a country on a given passport. Give visaType (e.g. O-1A, UK-GTV) or a destination country. Examples: UK visitor visa requirements for a Turkish citizen (destination GB, nationality TR), Schengen visa for Germany (destination DE), O-1A criteria, UK Global Talent requirements. Covers 18 visas in the US, UK, EU, Canada and Australia; read-only, no personal data needed.

visaType.description: Visa Engine visa key, e.g. O-1A (US extraordinary ability), UK-GTV (UK Global Talent), UK-SV (UK Standard Visitor), EU-SCHENGEN (Schengen short stay), B-1/B-2 (US visitor). Call list_supported_routes for the full list.

destination.description: Country the person wants to visit, as an ISO code or English name (e.g. DE, Germany, GB). Used to find the visitor visa when visaType is not given.

nationality.description: The traveller's passport country (e.g. TR, India). Adds whether a visitor visa is needed.

tripDays.description: Length of the stay in days. Only used for the Schengen funds figure.

locale.description: Language for names and explanations: en, tr, es or pt. Defaults to en.

tools.name: check_visa_readiness
tools.description: Readiness check for one visa. For visitor visas (US B-1/B-2, UK Standard Visitor, Schengen, Canada visitor, Australia 600) it takes the traveller's passport country, destination, purpose, month, trip length and a short list of answers, and returns a readiness band, areas, findings and recommendations; it says which questions to ask when something is missing, and says so when no visa is needed. For talent and student visas (e.g. O-1A, UK Global Talent) it lists the criteria and marks which ones the person says they have something for, by criterion key; this is self-reported, unverified and not an eligibility decision. Examples: how ready am I for a UK visitor visa, check my Schengen application readiness, which O-1A criteria do I still need evidence for. It gives no approval probability or processing time and stores nothing.

visaType.description: Visa Engine visa key, e.g. O-1A (US extraordinary ability), UK-GTV (UK Global Talent), UK-SV (UK Standard Visitor), EU-SCHENGEN (Schengen short stay), B-1/B-2 (US visitor). Call list_supported_routes for the full list.

locale.description: Language for names and explanations: en, tr, es or pt. Defaults to en.

nationality.description: Visitor visas: the traveller's passport country, as an ISO alpha-2 code (TR) or English name.

destination.description: Visitor visas: ISO alpha-2 code of the country travelled to. For EU-SCHENGEN, the Schengen state (e.g. IT). For a national visa it must be that visa's country (UK-SV: GB, B-1/B-2: US, CA-TRV: CA, AU-600: AU) and defaults to it.

purpose.description: Visitor visas: why the person travels.

travelMonth.description: Visitor visas: roughly when, as YYYY-MM, from last month to two years ahead.

tripLength.description: Visitor visas: how long the trip lasts.

answers.description: Visitor visas: question id to chosen option value (a list for multiple-choice questions). Leave out to be told which questions to ask.

selfReportedCriteria.description: Talent and student visas: criterion keys the person says they have something for. Keys only, never a description of the person's achievements. Get the keys from get_visa_requirements.
